title: Cold Case

Lilly and Jeffries reopen a case when the mother of a murdered boy finds a letter suggesting that his death was not a random act of violence.

title: Cold Case
description:

During the reinvestigation of a ballplayer found bludgeoned to death in 1945, Lilly and Jeffries run out of leads and must retrace their steps if they hope to collar the killer.

title: FBI

title: FBI

When a controversial senior leader from Egypt comes to New York for a heart transplant, OA struggles to balance his personal opinion with his professional duty when he is assigned to the security detail.

title: Cold Case

An elderly woman who died of natural causes was using the identity of a woman who disappeared after being committed to a mental hospital in the 1950s.

title: Cold Case
description:

A woman loses her fourth son to gang violence, and Lilly determines to stop the cycle and save her remaining child by convicting gang leader Miguel Maldonado.

title: Cold Case
description:

Recovery of an electronic diary prompts the team to reopen the investigation into the death of a healthy young woman who suffered a stress-induced heart attack when her dot-com company crashed.

title: FBI
description:

The team must infiltrate a drug trafficking gang after the robbery of a chemical plant leaves two customs agents dead; Nestor offers his help on the case, giving Maggie new insight into his character.

title: FBI

The team hunts a killer who is fatally shooting seemingly unrelated targets; new agent Tiffany Wallace experiences tension between her work as an FBI agent and the responsibility she feels to her community as a Black woman.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E08 — Walk the Line
After a bomb leaves three people dead, the team presses a reluctant informant to gather information from his close friends who are under suspicion; OA and his girlfriend clash over where the informant's rights lie.

title: FBI
description:

When a reporter is kidnapped and held without a ransom demand, the team must dig into her past relationships in order to pin down her assailant's motive; Isobel's relationship comes under fire when the case makes a connection to her boyfriend.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E10 — Checks and Balances
The team must track down two assailants who wear animal masks while committing armed robberies; Tiffany and Scola butt heads on whether to accept the local NYPD's offer to help in the investigation.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E11 — Brother's Keeper
After a man is killed by an explosive package shipped to his home, the team attempts to capture the sender and intercept his latest deadly parcel; Maggie struggles to trust her younger sister.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E12 — Fathers and Sons
The team rushes to track down two doctors abducted by a desperate father willing to do anything to save his son; Jubal's uncertainty in his family life affects his judgment during the hostage situation.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E13 — Short Squeeze
When the CEO of a major brokerage firm is killed while surrounded by protesters, the team looks into who had the most to lose from his company's perceived manipulations; Scola's previous Wall Street career and the reasons he left come to light.

title: FBI
description:
S03 E14 — Trigger Effect
While investigating a mass casualty incident at a New York City restaurant, the team scrambles to determine if it was racially motivated and if there was more than one gunman; Maggie starts to notice troubling behavior from her co-worker Elise.

title: FBI

After a young woman is killed on her way home from a lavish yacht party, the team investigates who she was and how she came to be at the event.

title: FBI

Maggie, OA and the team must stop a hacker who is disabling life-saving equipment in several New York City hospitals; Jubal's son waits for important surgery at one of the impacted hospitals.

title: FBI

The team finds a connection between bombings and a private veterans' club in New York City; Isobel tells a reluctant OA to recruit a former Army buddy for intel.

title: FBI

The team hunts for a serial killer who is targeting young, homeless men; Tiffany and Scola don't see eye to eye on how to handle the case.

After a suburban woman is kidnapped from her home, the team looks into trysts on both sides of a seemingly perfect marriage; OA feels pressure from Mona to make changes in his career path.

The team must track down a shooter targeting detectives from the same precinct and unit while facing mounting tension from the NYPD; Tiffany finds that her NYPD roots may be influencing her view of the situation.

title: FBI

After a young girl is kidnapped from her daycare, the team must help her parents navigate a debt owed to the deadly gang in their neighborhood; Maggie struggles to focus on the case when her sister returns from rehab.

Jubal's longtime confidential informant brings intel of an impending large-scale terror attack to the team, but when the details don't add up, Jubal must sift out the truth from a man who's known him at his worst.

title: FBI
description:

When a gunman opens fire at a homeless shelter, the team is led toward a killer with connections to a Mexican cartel.

title: FBI
description:

When the team's sex trafficking sting operation goes sideways, they race to recover a victim; Maggie makes a connection with a 911 operator to help find the girl before she is whisked out of the city or worse.

title: FBI

After two jurors for a high-profile mafia trial are gunned down, the team jumps into an organized crime investigation; Scola learns that one of his former drill instructors from the military academy he attended may be linked.

Anthony Davis pranks the NFL's Jayden Daniels and Braden Fiske during a senior-citizen fitness PSA that spirals when a fight breaks out.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E16 — Family First
The shooting of a federal corrections officer leads the team to an ex-Marine who has gone rogue ever since he returned from Afghanistan; Tiffany's sister looks to her for guidance when their younger brother begins to lash out.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E17 — Imminent Threat -- Part Two
Maggie calls in Remy to aid Scola in his undercover mission to find the terrorists believed to be responsible for the imminent attack in New York.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E18 — Obligation
When the deputy commander of an Air National Guard Base is kidnapped, the team must work quickly to find the suspect along with stolen ammunition; Scola questions his own safety in the aftermath of a recent traumatic experience.

title: FBI
description:
S07 E15 — Acolyte
As Maggie and the team search for New York's latest serial killer, the copycat method used by the murderer forces Maggie to seek help from Ray DeStefano, the serial slasher she put behind bars.

title: FBI
description:
S07 E16 — Covered
When an undercover FBI agent is killed in the field, the team makes the unnerving discovery that the identities of multiple undercover agents have been compromised, including Maggie who has been actively working to infiltrate an eco-terrorist group.

title: FBI
description:
S07 E17 — Lineage
When a famous rapper and two teen fans are gunned down on his tour bus, the team discovers there may be more to the story than his feud with another rapper; Isobel hits a major milestone that has her contemplating her future at the Bureau.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E19 — Sins of the Past
When a trucker is gunned down after a routine trip from Canada, all signs point the team to a noted criminal on the FBI's Most Wanted Terrorists list; Jubal gets to work with an old friend and colleague, Detective Jack Lombardo.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E20 — Sisterhood
A drug dealer is shot in a federal park and the team sets out to look for his killer; Maggie's sister returns to New York and complicates the case.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E21 — Privilege
All eyes are on the team when it tries to find out who kidnapped the only child of a prominent U.S. senator; the abduction also uncovers a potential link to a similar case that was pushed to the side by local authorities.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E22 — Torn
After finding a group of teens dead from a drug overdose, the team races to find the dangerous dealer and his supplier; OA questions where he stands in his faith.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E23 — God Complex
When a prominent doctor is found dead in a ritualistic slaying, the team must race against time to hunt down a religiously motivated serial killer; Scola faces a life-or-death decision.

title: FBI
description:
S06 E01 — All the Rage
When a bus explosion kills several innocent people, the team jumps into action to take down the responsible terrorist organization; Scola tries to balance fatherhood with the job.
